text: <speak>I found an order related to your $session.params.line_of_business service. Your appointment is on $session.params.day_of_week, $session.params.month_name <say-as interpret-as="ordinal">$session.params.date_of_month</say-as>. The Technician can arrive any time between $session.params.startTime and $session.params.endTime. And remember, an appointment scheduled from $session.params.startTime to $session.params.endTime can start at $session.params.endTimeUpdated and finish later.</speak>

N'oubliez pas qu'un rendez-vous prévu entre $session.params.startTime et $session.params.endTime peut commencer à $session.params.endTimeUpdated et se terminer plus tard.</speak>
